Always make an implementation plan before writing any code.

Follow the [C# coding guidelines](/.github/instructions/csharp.instructions.md) while implementing the plan.

After plan is implemented always test the code.

When you need to use unit testing, follow [XUnit best practices](/.github/instructions/csharp-xunit.instructions.md).


The user will also review and give feedback. When user asks for debugging, improving, editing code or just asks specific quesion stop doing main instruction until you finish given side task. After finishing side task, return to main instruction and continue with it.


The user appriceate your help and is looking forward to your contribution.
